title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of solid quality captures a high‑energy 1982 show highlighted by a smoking China Cat and a killer Jack Straw.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally crisp and well‑balanced, though a few reviewers note vocal levels that sit too high in the mix. Musically the concert shines with a standout China‑Rider jam, an incendiary Jack Straw, and a powerful second set featuring Playin' in the Band; the first set is described by some as uneven. Overall the performance is viewed as one of the stronger 1982 dates despite isolated criticisms.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (over 20) praise both the music and soundboard quality, yielding a strong positive bias; a few critical comments pull the average down, resulting in an overall rating around 4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear overall with well‑articulated guitars; some listeners mention vocals a bit high in the mix, occasional balance issues between instruments, but no major dropouts.

poor_songs: First set (overall) – noted as sloppy by a few reviewers
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set is described as uneven and sometimes sluggish, while the second set picks up momentum with extended jams and tighter interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for great tone and loud guitar; some critics note occasional hung‑up solo spots and a few sloppy moments.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for strong slide work, "chromatic wash" tones, and overall solid playing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards are busy and occasionally over‑present in the mix; his vocal range is noted as high but not detrimental.
